image_policy.reproduction: exact bytes or same mode, size, RGB(A) pixels

commands: cat README.md answer_schema.json items.jsonl

python - <<'PY'
import json,os
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
items=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
os.makedirs('zoom',exist_ok=True)
print('Count',len(items))
for start in range(0,len(items),5):
 rows=[]
 for i,it in enumerate(items[start:start+5],start+1):
  w=Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB'); l=Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
  row=Image.new('RGB',(max(1500,w.width+20,l.width+20),w.height+l.height+55),'white'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(row); d.text((8,4),str(i)+' '+it['item_id'],fill='black'); row.paste(w,(8,25)); row.paste(l,(8,30+w.height)); rows.append(row)
 out=Image.new('RGB',(max(r.width for r in rows),sum(r.height for r in rows)),'white'); y=0
 for r in rows:out.paste(r,(0,y));y+=r.height
 out.save('zoom/b%02d.png'%(start//5+1))
PY
